- `/Users/inhaus/Documents/GitHub/marketing-api/dashboard/report_templates/nutri.html:43`: `rowPlatform` prioritizes publisher fields for every row, so direct Facebook/Instagram content can be reassigned by a nested conflicting publisher value. - `/Users/inhaus/Documents/GitHub/marketing-api/tests/test_dashboard_reporting.py:805`: the publisher test verifies only spend KPIs; trend values and content attribution/deduplication are untested despite being explicit requirements. Assert per-channel trend totals and content rows.
- `/Users/inhaus/Documents/GitHub/marketing-api/tests/test_dashboard_reporting.py:651`: instrumentation captures thrown errors and rejected promises, but not `console.error`, so the explicit console-error requirement can regress unnoticed. Intercept `console.error` or consume Chrome console logs.
